bullets.title: 17 English Words that Come From Japanese
bullets.note:
There were quite a few surprises for me in this list, even as someone who
speaks and reads Japanese. The background context is an adventure and shows
you how hybridized nearly all language is. There are no “pure” modern
languages.**

bullets.title: Osprey Packs: The Porter
bullets.note:
One of the most versatile travel bags I’ve ever used. The Porter features
padded sidewalls for protecting your gear and clothing, a dedicated and padded
laptop/tablet sleeve, and a deployable shoulder harness and hipbelt for
backpack-style carry when you need it. This was introduced to me by a champion
ultra-endurance athlete who uses it for everything.**
